title: Animated mascots in the app: shared clip queue, landing crew, prompt box ledge

reason: Unblocked 2026-09-20: MPI-760 and MPI-771 closed, the set is cut out (103 GIFs), transitions exist. The alpha WebM gap no longer gates the work - Fabio chose queue-first against the stills, so Phase 2 runs before Phase 1.
Phase 2 starting: the shared clip queue. Fabio gave the go 2026-09-21 after MPI-846 was unblocked; the queue is format-agnostic behind heroCrew._poseSrc so it needs none of the asset decisions.

Phase 1 shipped as 088e7939: 95 clips staged as alpha WebM, 13.7 MB. Format chosen on measurement (GIF ~305 MiB VRAM for five mascots vs ~13 MiB for WebM). A light rim Fabio spotted by eye was a straight-alpha resize, now premultiplied and guarded by --verify, proven red at +7.26. Originals backed up to MadPony-Identity e8c3228, committed but NOT pushed. Card stays in `doing` for Phases 3-5.
Phase 3 built: heroCrew.js on the shared clip queue, _poseSrc and the .webp stills gone from the landing.

Phase 3 self-verification: 1779/0 tests, eslint clean, real Electron on its own port showing hover and click interrupts, 0 play() calls after teardown, reduced motion holding frame 0. Verify mode is user-ux, so Fabio's look at the landing is outstanding.
